package.name: starport_wuji_hand
package.description: Ethernet Wuji Hand 2 driver over wuji_sdk (UDP broadcast discovery, selection by serial number), 20-DoF joint-position command in radians with a guard chain (finite check, limit clamp, slew-rate limit, command watchdog), JointState feedback and DiagnosticArray health; vendored from Multiply Labs' starport_wuji_hand (BSD-3-Clause).
